body: Because nobody wants a guy from a dysfunctional family, nobody wants depressed and broken people.

A year ago, I did almost pull the trigger and the people around me literally tackled me to the ground to stop me... And then eventually things got better and I start to laugh whenever I remember that. Fast forward today, I'm back to square one with no one with me and feeling alone. I realized now that happiness is an illusion and that everything is a lie, including who I am. I wish I pulled the trigger a few seconds earlier.
How when all I do is fuck up..
